events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis' iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' was originally released on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe impact
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since its original release, Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' is still a monumental album. What's your go-to track from their debut?

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock memories
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, Woodstock brought together half a million people for three days of peace and music. Which legendary performance would you have loved to see live?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: We remember the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Elvis's legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, 49 years after his passing. His music lives on – what's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album was originally released on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road tracks
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' album, featuring that unforgettable cover, was originally released 57 years ago. What's your top track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to The Pretenders' frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde's hits
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! From 'Brass in Pocket' to 'Don't Get Me Wrong', what's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to Oasis and Beady Eye frontman, Liam Gallagher, born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher's voice
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Whether it's Oasis or solo, what's your favourite tune featuring that unmistakable voice?

events.title: The original iPod anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: First iPod memories
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple launched a device that changed how we listen to music forever. What was your first iPod model?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years since 'Dr. No' hit screens. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate 007 theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, born in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's genius
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His incredible songwriting continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon moment?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Cleese's comedy
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius John Cleese! From 'Fawlty Towers' to Monty Python, what's his most memorable role for you?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was originally released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album tracks
angles.copy: The Beatles' sprawling 'White Album' was originally released 58 years ago. With its incredible variety, what's your standout track from the double LP?
